title: GCP-AI Agent
intro: Once enabled, just talk in either GCP-AI chat interface and it can operate ToolsGCP for you. This page is only its configuration screen.
sec_switch_desc: When on, GCP-AI can operate ToolsGCP for you. When off, it only chats normally. This is the same switch as the one in Settings.
switch_hint_on: GCP-AI can operate ToolsGCP for you right now.
switch_hint_off: GCP-AI only chats right now; when you ask it to act, it will point you back here.
switch_unavailable: Agent is unavailable (the main window is not ready yet). Try opening this page again later.
sec_modules_desc: Every "hand" of the AI lives in there and can be toggled one by one. When the master switch is on, they all default to on.
modules_desc: Disabled modules are neither advertised to the AI nor executed — that saves tokens and stops it from reaching for a hand that isn't there.
modules_empty: No modules registered yet. The Agent can only chat right now.
sec_actions_desc: Every action the Agent takes is logged here, newest first (only the latest few are kept; they are gone when the app closes).
actions_empty: No activity yet. Ask the AI to do something in a chat window and this will fill up.
